items.label: Features
items.value: Dokotoo Womens Tops feature with 3/4 Length Sleeve, Striped Color Block, Crochet Hollow Out, Crewneck, Side Slits, High Low, Drop Shoulder, Summer Sweaters for Women Lightweight, Oversized Fit, Slight Stretch, Casual and fashion style fits for any body shape, and a sweater or cover up necessary for women wardrobe.

items.label: Design
items.value: Embrace boho vibes with unique women sweaters featuring bold color block stripes and a trendy crochet hollow out pattern. The playful mix of colors and open-knit texture create a laid-back summer feel, making it a must-have for fans of boho tops for women and fashion-forward beach cover ups for women.

items.label: Material
items.value: Crafted from high-quality, skin-friendly yarns, our womens sweaters deliver all-day comfort and keep you cool even on warmer days. The fabric retains its shape and colors wash after wash—simply hand wash or use a gentle machine cycle for easy care, so you can wear your favorite swimsuit coverup for women all season long.

items.label: Match
items.value: Layer this crochet sweater over swimwear for the perfect bathing suit cover up for women, or team it with shorts, jeans, leggings, or skirts for everyday dressing. Its oversized, slouchy style looks great over tanks or camis—making it one of the most versatile womens summer tops for all your mix-and-match needs.

items.label: Occasion
items.value: Striped color block hollow out knit sweater is perfect choice for casual daily life, beach, cruise, resort wear, country concert, party, school, vacation, holiday, work, home, date, outdoor and any other occasions in Spring, Summer or Fall. Perfect gift for mom,wife,daughter,girlfriend,or to your own.
